key_findings: Single-cell and network analyses prioritize FN1, DCN, CCN2, EGFR and COL1A1 as ECM candidates in intervertebral disc degeneration; DCN shows a nominal positive MR association, FN1 does not.
FN1 or DCN knockdown in TNF-alpha-treated nucleus pulposus cells lowers selected matrix and inflammatory markers.
